D: A freed man teams up with a German bounty hunter to rescue his wife.
P: Serve the beer when Dr Schultz pours two at the empty saloon.
S: Soft baked pretzels with rock salt, grainy mustard and butter
Pretzel dough proved, shaped, dipped in hot bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with grainy mustard and butter.
Beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and smoked paprika, dried overnight
Beef topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, pepper and smoked paprika overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
Schultz's winter camp pumpkin and lentil soup
The snowbound winter Django learns the bounty trade

Roast pumpkin and red lentils simmered with onion, cumin and stock, with buttered rye bread for dunking. Soften the onion and garlic in the oil with the cumin. Add the pumpkin, lentils and stock and simmer until soft. Blitz until smooth and season. Serve with buttered rye bread.
M: Grilled bratwurst, sauerkraut with apple and caraway, buttered potatoes
Bratwurst grilled slowly until browned, sauerkraut braised with white wine, apple and caraway, buttered potatoes.
Bounty hunter rib eye and skillet spuds
a campfire supper on the trail

Heavily peppered rib eye seared in cast iron and butter-basted, with crisp skillet potatoes and onions and a smoky bourbon steak sauce. Season 4 rib eye steaks heavily with salt and cracked pepper. Fry 1kg diced parboiled potatoes and 1 sliced onion in a cast iron pan with oil and butter for 15 minutes until crisp. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side, basting with butter, garlic and thyme, then rest. Simmer 100ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp bourbon, 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp smoked paprika for 3 minutes.
W: Two-layer white vanilla cake with buttercream frosting

Light white butter cake with fluffy vanilla frosting, served in tall slices. Beat 170g butter with 300g sugar, add 4 egg whites and vanilla, then fold in 300g plain flour, 3 tsp baking powder and 250ml milk.
K: German wheat beer poured slowly over lemon honey syrup in a tall mug

Cloudy German wheat beer poured slow into tall mugs over a spoon of lemon and honey syrup, a thick head and a lemon wheel on the rim. Simmer 60g honey, 60ml water and the peeled zest of a lemon for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Add 1 tbsp syrup and a squeeze of lemon to each of 4 chilled tall mugs. Pour in a 500ml German wheat beer slowly, tilting the mug, then straighten to build a thick head. Hang a lemon wheel on each rim.

s.note: Soft baked pretzels with rock salt, grainy mustard and butter
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm water and prove an hour. Shape 8 pretzels, dip in simmering water with 3 tbsp bicarb, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with grainy mustard and butter.

s.note: Beef jerky marinated in soy, Worcestershire and smoked paprika, dried overnight
s.how: Slice 500g partly frozen beef topside very thin. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, cracked pepper and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dry on racks at 70C for 4 hours.

m.note: Grilled bratwurst, sauerkraut with apple and caraway, buttered potatoes
m.how: Simmer a jar of sauerkraut with 125ml white wine, a grated apple and 1 tsp caraway for 20 minutes. Grill 8 bratwurst slowly until browned. Boil 800g potatoes and toss in butter.

w.note: Two-layer white vanilla cake with buttercream frosting
w.how: Beat 170g butter with 300g sugar, add 4 egg whites and vanilla, then fold in 300g plain flour, 3 tsp baking powder and 250ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 28 minutes. Fill and cover with 200g butter beaten with 400g icing sugar.

d.note: German wheat beer poured slowly over lemon honey syrup in a tall mug

Pour in a 500ml German wheat beer slowly, tilting the mug, then straighten to build a thick head. Hang a lemon wheel on each rim.
